remarks: Welcome to your stunning coastal retreat in the heart of Redondo Beach! Tucked away in a sought-after South Bay neighborhood, this 4-bed, 2.5-bath home at 2216 Pullman Lane, Unit B sits at the rear of a two-home lot with no HOA, blending modern elegance and privacy. Spanning 2,240 sq. ft. , this 2001-built property maximizes space and natural light, featuring the added safety benefit of a fire sprinkler system throughout the interior and garage. Step inside to an open-concept living space featuring hardwood floors, a fireplace, and a main-level half bath.
